integrity: The theorem uses exact symbolic identities and full finite-range Sturm signs, together with analytic coefficient and root-order arguments for all large sizes. Independence is not claimed. Possible unindexed equivalent results remain a literature risk.
scientific_limitations: Exact analysis is for unweighted connected graphs of the form \(K_2\square K_n\), integers \(n\ge2\), and the [2/2] Padé diffusion end-step in exact arithmetic; not arbitrary networks, stages, or rounding-sensitive implementations.
title: Reentrant positivity for fourth-order Gauss steps on two-row rook graphs
